column1: # ⛔ CLOSED 2026-09-06. Every package below is in the population now, and the gap this file recorded
# is zero. Keep it: the SHAPE of the hole is what discover-install-scripts.mjs guards against, and the
# three-platform sweep of exactly this set (uncovered-above-gate-sweep-*.tsv) is evidence about it.
# It also records how the hole was found and then re-found. The 137 rows here were measured with a
# top-3 window; a top-5 window over the same 25,421 packages found 362 carriers rather than 244, and
# the shipped rule -- no window at all, with each package's install-script releases summed against a
# 1% download floor -- finds 420. So closing these 137 did not close the band, and the band was only
# closed once the rule stopped depending on a number chosen by hand.
# Install-script carriers ABOVE the population's download gate (ranks 1-25,500) that the sweep did
# 309 of 25,421 packages were unresolved, so this list was a floor.
